findings.claim: Post-minimum EER deterioration despite lower logged training objective is observed. Overfitting and constant-LR oscillation are candidate mechanisms, not individually identified causes.

The isolated global-BPL change has mixed and comparatively small best-EER effects, and both batch160 runs share the epoch35 DF spike. BPL scope alone does not explain the major generalization fluctuations.
Batch240 changes OC sample count, bonafide centroid estimation, BPL pair mixture and training iteration count together. Better 19LA cannot be attributed solely to BPL pairs.
findings.status: verified configuration changes; causal contributions unseparated

findings.claim: Pair averaging prevents N^2 from becoming an N^2 multiplier on BPL. More positive pairs do not add the opposite-class negatives of CLIP.
LR10x and batch2x jointly accelerate fitting versus old80; old80 already has better DF at epoch50, so longer training alone cannot explain the DF gap.
findings.status: observed pattern; separate LR/batch effects unresolved

findings.claim: Current beta1=30 is the official later journal setting; cited2025 benchmark used beta1=5, batch30,150epochs. It is not a controlled reproduction of that benchmark.
Batch320 is a memory failure with no completed evaluation; it says nothing about achievable EER.

recommendations: Keep the in-progress batch240 run as scheduled and evaluate its final50 result before a final comparison.
Prioritize an otherwise fixed experiment with late LR decay, and choose checkpoints on an independent validation set. This tests a supported candidate mechanism; improvement is not guaranteed.
For causal separation of the old80 versus50 difference, compare lr1e-6 and1e-5 at the same batch, duration and evaluation procedure.
For a2025 reproduction, explicitly use that version's documented settings; beta1=5 versus30 is a separate controlled experiment, not an assumed fix.
If adding bonafide-spoof contrastive learning later, evaluate it as a distinct loss change rather than assuming larger positive-only BPL reproduces CLIP.
limits: Four successful configurations, one seed each; no randomized repeated causal comparison.
Old80 changes lr, batch and duration jointly. Batch240 changes both sample count per iteration and iteration count, and its final50 evaluation is not yet available.

Training loss averages logged windows: for batch160 each window17 iterations, nine windows153/162; batch240 each11, nine windows99/108. The remaining epoch tail is not logged, so these are within-run diagnostic proxies.
Test trajectory minima from different checkpoints are descriptive and must not be combined into one best model or used as independent validation.
No embedding variance, gradient norm/noise, per-attack false-positive/false-negative breakdown or additional model evaluation was measured.

official_readme.qualification: The current code's beta1=30 matches the later journal tuning; it is not the beta1=5 used for the cited 2025 Table1 results. This is a comparison-version difference, not evidence that30 is erroneous.

clip.distinction: CLIP separates N matched positive pairs from N^2-N mismatches; this BPL attracts all bonafide long-short pairs and has no spoof negatives.

code_verified_facts.bpl: mean(softplus(30*(1-cos(x_i,y_j)))-0.3) over every bonafide long-short pair; both embeddings L2-normalized
code_verified_facts.first_stage: centroid loss.weight frozen; classifier updated from OCSoftmax+BPL using bona and spoof
code_verified_facts.second_stage: classifier frozen; centroid updated using bonafide long-view OCSoftmax
code_verified_facts.loss_logging: loss1+loss2 accumulated by flag_parent and reset after each >=10%-of-epoch window; nine full windows per epoch
code_verified_facts.optimizer: Adam; classifier+PLM parameters; two calls to optimizer.step per training iteration
code_verified_facts.scheduler: CosineAnnealingWarmRestarts but eta_min==initial_lr; logs verify a constant LR throughout each run
code_verified_facts.classifier_normalization: LayerNorm found; no BatchNorm call in b_linear.py
code_verified_facts.frontend: plm.eval() and no-gradient execution through T_0=150; all runs <=80 epochs

validation.visual_inspection: Four PNG panels inspected: all three settings, loss-window qualification, epoch45 DF update, labels and axis ranges readable; no clipping or overlap observed.
